notes.title: 🌱 Solarpunk Dev Update – Logic Systems, Animals & New Recipes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re back with a big development update. A lot has happened over the past few weeks, and the world of Solarpunk is really coming together. Let’s jump right in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/72bf2c2bfd8bd758411870d001cb3fa6d845d419.jpg
(Take a look at the trade bot!)

⚡ Advanced Power Logic

We have implemented a brand-new logic system for electricity! You can now use switches to turn entire networks (or parts of them) on and off, plus new sensors add some real automation magic:


 Rain sensors that can disable sprinklers when it rains
 Day/Night sensors to automatically turn on your lights at night
 The system opens up creative possibilities!
 There’s also now an electric version of the furnace, instead of using materials, it runs on electricity.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/dd8e78c31cd083f991579eb9aeed157cedb35604.png
(WIP: Electric furnace concept)

🐮 Animals Are (Almost) Here!

We have also been working hard on our animal systems, and here’s what’s already in place:


 Animals are now implemented on the programming side and ready for testing
 We implemented the breeding system
 Happy animals produce loot
 Animals get a random name when they spawn – but you can rename them using an Animal Tag
 Animal transport is now possible! You can use a Transport Item to send animals to a Receiving Station you place anywhere on your base
 Certain items (like the Beehive) can now only be placed in specific biomes. No bees in the snowy mountains, it's just too cold!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/c1dd7e0a6e96dae714acba9bdde9c493d5902325.jpg
(WIP: Drones can now help you automate processes.)

🍅 New Crops & Cooking System

After some spontaneous consideration, we decided to add a cooking system to the game to give it even more depth. We’ve added several new plants like tomatoes, carrots, paprika, and watermelon. 

The first version of the cooking system now has 10 recipes that offer useful bonuses (like reduced hunger or thirst for a few minutes).

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Performance Improvements

While one of us focused on new features, the other has been deep in balancing and polishing.
Most of the changes are small but impactful. Here are a few examples:


 You only respawn in bed if it’s actually inside a house with a floor (no more falling into the void!)
 A Recycler lets you turn almost anything into "Recycling Points" (name might change). You’ll use these points to unlock skins and fun extras from the vending machine
 Airship repair kits work again and are easier to use
 New item icons, recipes, and tutorial text
 Balanced airship stats and trading quests
 Fixed bugs, improved island positioning, and added new plants
 Now, when you die, you drop your items with a particle effect so you can easily find them again
 Several bugs in the energy system have been ironed out
 Fixed a crash related to inventory items and crafting/rewards
 Starving in the airship now works correctly
 Diamond tools are finally fully functional
 Performance has been significantly improved across the board


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/1034457faf25dd21cf64b11af73e02e4c0df5f32.jpg
(WIP: We added maps to the game so you can locate islands and you can set your own markers.)

That’s it for now! Thank you so much for your ongoing support and patience. Every update brings us closer to a world we can't wait to share with you. 

For even more exchange or if you have any questions, join our Discord server 👈
and become part of the Solarpunk community.

Until next time,

The Solarpunk Team

notes.title: 🏠 Huge building system update, We won 2 OTK Awards, New Trailer
notes.notes:
Hello Solarpunk Community 👋!

We've made significant advancements to our building system over the past few weeks, transitioning from collision channels to a tag-snap system. This gives users much more freedom when building their dream homes in Solarpunk.
[previewyoutube=CTjgLXj2VXE;full][/previewyoutube]
📑 Summary of what we have done in the last weeks!

 Building System
[olist]
 Changed the building system from collision channels to a tag snap system. So we theoretically have an infinite number of snap possibilities for example: Walls, roof slopes, columns, decorations, plants, electronic components and so on. Previously we were very limited in this respect.
 There is now a system with which buildings can have special rules for building in individual cases. For example, carpets can be placed under furniture if the furniture is already in place. Wall shelves automatically rotate towards the wall so that they hang from it. Hanging plants can only be hung from the ceiling up to a certain angle and so on.
 A system has been built in which ensures that buildables like decorations, cannot be built into each other. Due to a limitation in the Unreal engine, dynamic previews that have not yet been built can only have "simple collisions", which consist of boxes or similar simple shapes. However, we wanted it to be possible to place a candle on the edge of a furnace (for example). We therefore developed the system so that every buildable object has two possible collisions. A simple one for building and a complex (much more precise) one when the object is built. This way we can have the best of both worlds if necessary.
[/olist]

 Building preview is no longer displayed if you have a placeable in your hand and a UI open
 "Building rules" such as "Can only be built on land" or "Can only be built on water" have been added.
 Floating water drone rework (which you can already see in the trailers). Now has floats that limit the area in which the drone fishes items out of the water and a box in which the drone brings the items, where you can then collect them as a player.
 Sky environment improved. Clouds have been reworked. The sun now shines through the clouds better and adapts to the colour mood of the sun.
 Weather system improved. Now have more control over weather changes and leaves and sticks fly through the air during thunderstorms
 System prototyped so that you can be hit by whirling objects in a storm and take damage. It also takes into account the direction the wind is coming from, so you can take cover behind hills or walls from flying things.

🤗 We won a custom made PC & $10.000
During the OTK Games Expo, an event hosted by the Youtuber Asmongold, the community voted Solarpunk as "Best Trailer" and we won $10.000. We also won an Award for "Most unique Artstyle" and we will receive a custom made Solarpunk-themed PC from Starforge System. Over 300.000 people watched the event live and we are so incredibly grateful for our community.  You are amazing 😍!
[previewyoutube=jLKCR676xU0;full][/previewyoutube]

📹The latest trailer
In the light of the Games baked in Germany Steam event we have created a new trailer. You can watch it here.
[previewyoutube=U5tVI1RN1cY;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope you enjoyed the news here and leave us a comment or your opinion on what you would like to know in the next update.

You can always join our Dev-Discord and ask us what we are currently working on.
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/8wPsjDxTyQ

Best regards
Cyberwave & rokaplay Team


Games We Love ❤️
Lou's Lagoon - Run a seaplane delivery service!

Run a seaplane delivery service and find Uncle Lou! Traverse the vibrant Limbo Archipelago in search of your Uncle Lou, who mysteriously disappeared and left you his seaplane delivery service. Explore the islands, harvest resources, and hone your crafting skills to complete jobs and grow your business!

notes.title: Community Update: 500,000 Wishlists, OTK Expo Success, Xbox Offer, and More!
notes.notes:
Hello Solarpunk Community! 🌞
The past few days have been quite eventful for us! We reached 500,000 wishlists on Steam, participated in the OTK Expo, won an award, and even made an offer to Xbox that went viral. But let's start with a new trailer. 🎥
[previewyoutube=FWJ_SjDP7w8;full][/previewyoutube]
In the trailer, we show the latest changes that you might already know from the devlogs. If you want to know more, please read the latest update: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1805110/view/6216734321428869830
500,000 Wishlists on Steam 🌟
It’s simply incredible, but we’ve achieved the seemingly impossible and reached 500,000 wishlists on Steam. This means 500,000 people find the game interesting and have added it to their list. WOW, that’s amazing! With this, we are now ranked 45 on Steam’s most upcoming games.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/81c1452a21df3bc8a9b2e9d0b2a9dc4c29a33d6a.jpg
OTK Showcase 🏆
At the beginning of the year, we applied for the OTK Expo Showcase, hoping to participate. And what can we say, not only did we get to show exclusive material, but we also won the “Chat’s Choice” award and a prize of $10,000. Additionally, we received the Art Star Award for our "unique art style." In fact, the show was watched by hundreds of thousands of people on the main channel and co-streams. Asmongold, one of the show’s hosts, made it feel like a mini-Oscars ceremony. Want to watch? The awards start at 3:30:00:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=anIpIHOqivM
Offer to Xbox 🎮
On X/Twitter (it will always be Twitter :) ), we posted and asked the community: “Who would like to see our game on #Xbox Game Pass?”. The post went viral as the internet does its thing.

Larry Hryb, former Communications Director at Xbox, posted in response, referring to ID@Xbox Director Chris Charla. We couldn’t resist and made Xbox an offer to talk. We’ll keep you updated. Check it out for yourself and give it a thumbs up or repost it to keep us in the algorithm on Twitter... uh, X.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/e77bb4a10e7a7419a6cd48800af2c3494844c954.jpg
https://twitter.com/Solarpunk_Game/status/1796652384929681757

But you can still help us out. If more users like and share this post, our dream could become a reality. Let’s go, Crowd! 🚀

Thank you for your attention, and we'll see you in the next news update.

Best regards
Cyberwave & rokaplay Team

notes.title: Dev-Update: Airship facelift + new flight physic
notes.notes:
Hey Solarpunk community!

We're back with another exhilarating update on the Solarpunk frontier! 🌞✈️

🚀 Airship Makeover Extravaganza!

We have adjusted the look of the airship. Among the new features are the ingenious directional propellers, which are now clearly visible in 3rd person mode. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/2202901bf79fcead00bc34faa2563829ba8653fe.png

Get ready to fly through the skies in style! 🌪️ Check out the stunning visual overhaul in the attached images.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/2df3498f2f77d1f88cdfdfdb285d8e45e76c81bb.jpg

🛠️ Dock & new flight physics! 
Remember that Dock concept we teased last time? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/dd17afc240d9a47ce03bd0baa397bf3ee240d168.png

Well, buckle up, because it's officially in the game! You can upgrade your airship at the dock. The airship will land automatically as soon as you are near it and press the docking-button.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/d73ae49b3246474f037bfb71906c30d00cbd9a86.png[/th]
        [th] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/c7df1cc4a3e8378ce0c5777a6f7b5b3350831c56.png[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

We have also reworked the flight physics. The airship now flies much more comfortably. Fun fact: At the time we produced the trailer, the flying was extremely spongy and not polished at all. But it was enough for the trailer :D 

Take a look at the dock + the flight physics in this little clip.

[previewyoutube=LRfBbiSYJh0;full][/previewyoutube]

🩹Damage system
The airship now has a damage system. If you're not careful and hit something, it takes damage. From 50% damage it starts to smoke and is much more difficult to steer. If the damage reaches 100% or you crash directly into a wall at high speed, it breaks immediately. You will be able to craft repair kits to repair your airship. The hull can be upgraded later in the game so that the airship doesn't break so quickly.

🚧 A lot of what you see is still WIP and may differ from the final product! 🚧

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/81de8af99f604d2dd435f583260a7fe66c8eb71f.jpg

📖 Airship manual
In case you're wondering what all the Buttons/indicators mean, here's an explanation for those who like lists :).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/3a419f2a540fe729fba537efc50972c06844fd7c.png

Throttle:

Forward speed
Reverse gear

Docking Indicators:

Upper lamp: Indicates whether you can dock in the open. (Works everywhere as long as the airship is stationary and relatively straight. You can also dock in mid-air, for example)

Lower lamp: Indicates if you can dock at a dock (if the dock is within a radius of approx. 5 meters, you can dock there automatically)

Battery / Solar panel


 Battery is charged by the solar panel when exposed to sunlight
 Charges less quickly in the morning and evening than in the midday sun
 Also dependent on the weather. In the rain it charges slowly, in sunshine it charges quickly
 If covered by shade, also less charging power
 Flying consumes battery
 The faster you fly, the more energy the airship needs
 The small rotors also consume energy
 Light also consumes energy. (If you land at night and forget to switch off the light, your battery runs down because the solar panel does not charge the battery at night. So you shouldn't forget to switch the lights off again. Just like in a car)
 Solar charging indicator Indicates whether the battery is currently being charged or not


Altitude indicator


 Shows how far the airship is from the minimum and maximum altitude
 If the altitude is too low or too high, the autopilot switches on and automatically pulls the airship up/down again


Camera


 Free look around while flying
 1st/3rd person camera


Upgradeables:

Things that are not available from the start, but can be upgraded as the game progresses


 Chest: The chest is not in the airship from the start, and you have to install it first
 Holographic display: The Holo HUD is currently still very wip. It will show additional information such as exactly how much power is being consumed, how much the solarpanel charges and other information such as the level of damage taken, flight altitude, time, etc


[table]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/197dd350bfbd5868411b5ea1350204ebf9f8afa2.png [/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42064908/a4dba00a14cda425864b2eee4e43d3ea7decadc2.png [/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]


 Battery storage can be upgraded
 Solar panel charging speed can be upgraded
 Engine (more speed)
 Hull (less damage from collisions)
 Balloon can be upgraded so that you can fly higher overall with the airship


What do you think of these adjustments?
That's it for today. We would be delighted if you could tell us what you think about the adjustments in the comments. 

- Best regards from Cyberwave
